Subject: Sudden launch spike — need short window increase + credit?

Hey Sofia,

Quick note — we pushed a small A/B launch this morning and traffic spiked ~6x for a three-hour window. The app throttled and customers saw retries. Our engineering team traced it back to a model-heavy path that wasn't in our baseline.

Two asks: 1) Can Redwood open a short, provisional throughput window (48 hours) so we don't get throttled while we roll a fix? 2) Can we get a one-off overage credit or reduced overage rate for that window — we absorbed the operational impact and would like the invoice to reflect that.

We're flexible on commitment — if we agree a short true-up (we'll convert to a 3-month blended commit if this pattern persists) we'd appreciate a concession for this launch spike.

Attaching our usage snapshot for the day.

Thanks,
Sam

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for the usage snapshot. I’m sorry you hit throttling during the launch. We can help.

Immediate proposal (provisional):
- Open a temporary throughput allowance for 48 hours starting now (we can backdate if needed).
- Apply a 50% discount on any overage tokens during that 48-hour window as a one-time concession, capped at the equivalent of 24 hours of your peak delta.
- We’ll require a short mutual action plan: PilotScale confirms whether you want to convert the uplift into a 3-month true-up commit within 7 days; if you do, we’ll convert the provisional charge into a blended credit against the new commit.

Ben / Priyom — looping you in for pricing & PO flow. Can we get a provisional quote and a DocuSign for Sam to sign? I attached a draft note they can share with procurement.

Sam — if that sounds reasonable I’ll push the provisional window and Ben will follow with the quote and DocuSign.

Best,
